key_insight: QUFIG uses a circuit-DAG GNN to rank gate-fault pairs by predicted fidelity impact, enabling gate-level quantum fault vulnerability detection under limited inspection budgets.
engineering_relevance: This helps quantum engineers focus security and reliability checks on the most critical gates, improving targeted defenses for cloud-based quantum circuits.
method: Builds a GNN on the circuit DAG to model gate-level structure.
Predicts a vulnerability score for each gate–fault pair based on circuit fidelity impact.
Ranks pairs so the highest-risk faults are inspected first under a budget constraint.
evidence_signal: On QASMbench and HamLib MaxCut, QUFIG found high-impact vulnerable gate-fault pairs with fewer inspections than random and depth-based heuristics, reducing gates needing inspection by 2.9–19.8%.
watch_item: Performance depends on representative training/evaluation circuits and fault models, so generalization to unseen hardware or fault types should be validated carefully.
paper_title: QUFIG: GNN-Based Prediction of Quantum Fault Injection Vulnerabilities with Gate-Level Precision
